profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Research & Development | Tyto Athene | Go Developer| Problem Solver | Security & Compliance Automation | CrowdStrike | STIG / CIS | Cloud & Dashboarding | Fitness Enthusiast
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 25+ years of development experience.  With a skill set in Go, C, Java, PHP and SQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Minpoint Group / Tyto Athene

Lockdown Dashboard – Security Analysis & Compliance Platform

• Designed and developed a multi-threaded Go application to ingest, normalize, and analyze security 
    assessment data against STIG, CIS, and custom baselines.

• Built flexible data ingestion pipelines supporting local file uploads, AWS S3, and Azure Blob Storage.

• Architected a scalable PostgreSQL database schema to store compliance results, audit artifacts, and 
    historical security metrics.
  
• Implemented automated CSV export capabilities to support compliance reporting and audit workflows.

• Designed and delivered custom Grafana dashboards with hierarchical views enabling users to:

          • Monitor overall security compliance at both summary and detailed levels 

          • Analyze results by baseline type (STIG, CIS, custom frameworks)

          • Drill down into individual scans to identify passed and failed controls 

          • Track compliance trends and remediation progress over time
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Software Development · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Minpoint Group / Tyto Athene

Peregrine Application – CrowdStrike Integration Platform

• Architected and developed backend services in Go, integrating deeply with the CrowdStrike Falcon 
     API to enable secure, remote endpoint management for enterprise environments.

• Built core functionality including remote file exploration, task execution, command orchestration, and    
   Zero Trust score monitoring across distributed systems.

• Designed and implemented secure in-memory data handling and encryption mechanisms for sensitive 
   client configuration data.

• Optimized application performance, reducing host load times by ~75% while expanding available   
   telemetry and data fields.

• Developed multi-threaded processing workflows to improve scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.

• Implemented offline queuing and retry logic to maintain operational continuity during network 
   disruptions.

• Partnered closely with front-end engineers to debug and optimize Fyne-based GUI applications.

• Authored technical documentation, test procedures, and instructional videos for internal teams and 
   external customers.

company.name: MindPoint Group, A Tyto Athene Company

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•	Designed an enterprise application to create, process and reconcile print jobs totaling over 7.5 million dollars annually. 
•	Led a team of senior consultants to stabilize system architecture and data integrity across multiple platform, Live Cycle, Cognos, and Liferay. 
•	Successfully created stored procedure, design documents and a template that leadership utilized to model all future documentation.  
•	Created and updated existing web services on a SOA based project, allowing users to request various information for service members using web service requests.  
•	Researched business rule extraction software as well as business rules engines such and Corticon and Drools. 
•	Worked with venders to analyze their rules extraction software to leverage its capabilities with the refactored Java code. 
•	Manually extracted rules from the refactored Natural code that could be inserted into rules engine for deployment. 
•	Installed and created Drools projects to inject into refactored code using drools runtime environment as well as REST web service calls. 
•	Lead and organize events, meetings, community service, outdoor team building activities, coding practices and events for a group of 50 Deloitte employees

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description: •	Developed, designed and tested a car tracking database in php.

positions.title: Technology Specialist
positions.description:
•	Created web related automation tools using JavaScript, HTML, PHP and  jQuery.
•	Analyzed real estate related database solutions and design websites using Joomla and Wordpress templates.  
•	Created marketing campaigns for multiple niche groups and mini websites and squeeze tied to a created database
•	Documented processes and designed automated solutions to analyze real estate properties via websites.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and designed applications for file processing using Java on a Linux Platform.
•	Developed and designed web services.
•	Designed specification documentation to be use by developers for implementation. 
•	Designed web pages using jsp and xml to enhance customer experience. 
•	Created Test plans and automated test to efficiently test code created by myself and other development team members.
•	Created SQL scripts to enhance database functionality

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed/designed software in C on a Linux Platform for keyboard, video and mouse card including legacy and USB support   
•	Designed/developed Web interfaces in Cold Fusion to keep track of registered users to send update information about our card  
•	Tested video and device drivers for a keyboard, mouse, video, network and USB controller
•	Mentor new employees and assist them in there conversion from college to the corporate world
•	Integrated software and hardware components such as memory, processors and I/O into high-end servers  
•	Created software utilities to actively test hardware components using Visual Basic.  
•	Configured hardware and software configurations to run various tests  
•	Created installation and trouble-shooting release documents to be provided to customers  
•	Install, tests and debug server platform for Microsoft Windows 2000 and 2003 Server, Advance Server, and Datacenter
•	Tests and debug applications and programs on Windows 2000 and Windows 2003 Operating systems
